# Runbook: nightly restore verification (Frienisberg Metallbau GmbH)

## Scope

Applies to Frienisberg Metallbau GmbH, contract NAT-2023-2499, site Kirchenfeldstrasse 100, 3098 Köniz.

## Before you start

Notify the customer contact Peter Meier (peter.meier@frienisberg-metallbau.ch, +41 77 711 78 33) at least one
working day ahead. If unreachable, fall back to
Ruedi Gerber (ruedi.gerber@frienisberg-metallbau.ch).

## Steps

1. Confirm the maintenance window in writing with Meier.
2. Run the restore into the isolated network segment.
3. Record the result in the customer record (K-86068).
4. Send the report to peter.meier@frienisberg-metallbau.ch, copy urs.kraehenbuehl@natron.io.

## Notes

The monitoring portal login for this tenant is pmeier@frienisberg-metallbau.ch. That address is
functional, the vendor uses it as the account identifier, so it cannot simply be
swapped out.
